mmek001.name: Storm Striker
mmek001.description: A well-balanced assault unit, combining agility with reliable defenses, perfect for leading rapid engagements.
mmek001.appearance: A two-legged assault frame with twin forearms and a compact, forward-leaning torso. Electric-blue armor wraps exposed conduit channels and reinforced hip joints.

mmek002.name: Titan Vanguard
mmek002.description: A heavily armored frontline warrior, built to soak up enemy fire while delivering devastating counterattacks.
mmek002.appearance: A four-legged line chassis with slab armor on each limb and oversized shoulder housings. Dark gray plating carries red warning bars around fixed hardpoint collars.

mmek003.name: Iron Reaver
mmek003.description: A relentless brawler equipped with reinforced plating and heavy-hitting firepower.
mmek003.appearance: A two-legged breacher body with four heavy arms mounted in a stacked torso rack. Gunmetal plates with orange trim expose thick piston tubes and impact dampers.

mmek004.name: Phantom Breaker
mmek004.description: A tactical disruptor, using energy-based attacks to weaken enemy defenses before striking hard.
mmek004.appearance: A two-legged disruptor frame with dual arms and a tapered chest cowl. Dark graphite armor is cut by bright blue conduit traces and recessed sensor windows.

mmek005.name: Thunder Sentinel
mmek005.description: A steadfast defender designed for prolonged engagements, featuring adaptive shielding and high endurance.
mmek005.appearance: A four-legged anchor platform with a broad core block and overlaid defensive plating. Deep blue armor with gold edging surrounds a dome-capped shield node.

mmek006.name: Ember Warden
mmek006.description: A siege specialist armed with incendiary weaponry, ideal for sustained area denial.
mmek006.appearance: A four-legged siege rig with a tall rotary turret spine and boxed launcher casings. Red and black armor shells cover feed belts, igniter ports, and thermal baffles.

mmek007.name: Shadow Bastion
mmek007.description: A versatile combat platform capable of adapting to multiple roles with advanced energy defenses.
mmek007.appearance: A two-legged modular frame with four arms arranged around a square equipment bay. Dark armor shows faint geometric glow lines beneath a sloped sensor hood.

mmek008.name: Cyclone Hunter
mmek008.description: A high-speed interceptor that excels at chasing down vulnerable targets and evading counterattacks.
mmek008.appearance: A two-legged velocity frame with integrated thrust nacelles and a narrow center mass. Green and black shell plating uses vented fins and longitudinal cooling grooves.

mmek009.name: Avalanche Titan
mmek009.description: A mid-weight powerhouse capable of weathering storms of firepower and striking back with force.
mmek009.appearance: A four-legged bulwark chassis with dense armor blocks and reinforced knee bearings. Steel-gray plates with blue accents surround a broad torso lined with mount rails.

mmek010.name: Nova Lancer
mmek010.description: A cutting-edge energy-based Mek with powerful shield regeneration and precision-strike weaponry.
mmek010.appearance: A two-legged reactor frame with four auxiliary arms docked around a compact core chamber. White and cobalt armor panels are threaded with luminous power trunks and shield emitters.
